definitions.gloss: heterosexuality; attraction to the opposite sex
definitions.explanation: Sexual or romantic attraction to people of the opposite sex. Used in academic, medical, and social discourse about sexual orientation.

examples.japanese: {異性愛|いせいあい}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{性的指向|せいてきしこう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧だ。
examples.english: Heterosexuality is one type of sexual orientation.

examples.japanese: {異性愛|いせいあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前提|ぜんてい}→前提：08240_zentei⟧とした⟦{社会|しゃかい}→社会：01427_shakai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{見方|みかた}→見方：10072_mikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{見直|みなお}されている→見直す：04579_minaosu⟧。
examples.english: Social perspectives that assume heterosexuality are being reconsidered.

examples.japanese: {性的指向|せいてきしこう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{異性愛|いせいあい}、⟦{同性愛|どうせいあい}→同性愛：23993_douseiai⟧、{両性愛|りょうせいあい}⟦など→〜など：03095_nado⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あり→ある：00006_aru⟧、⟦{多様性|たようせい}→多様性：04825_tayousei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}する→尊重する：17456_sonchousuru⟧⟦{意識|いしき}→意識：01714_ishiki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{広|ひろ}がっている→広がる：01980_hirogaru⟧。
examples.english: Sexual orientations include heterosexuality, homosexuality, and bisexuality, among others, and awareness of respecting this diversity is spreading.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{異性|いせい}→異性：13568_isei⟧ (the opposite sex) and ⟦{愛|あい}→愛：02370_ai⟧ (love). The related adjective form is {異性愛|いせいあい}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧, and a person of this orientation is called {異性愛者|いせいあいしゃ} (heterosexual person).

This term is neutral and used in formal, academic, and journalistic contexts. In casual speech, ⟦ストレート→ストレート：11630_sutoreeto⟧ (straight) is also sometimes used as an English loanword.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {異性愛者|いせいあいしゃ}: heterosexual person
- {異性愛|いせいあい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{前提|ぜんてい}→前提：08240_zentei⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to assume heterosexuality
- {異性愛|いせいあい}⟦{規範|きはん}→規範：14160_kihan⟧: heteronormativity
- {異性愛|いせいあい}⟦{中心|ちゅうしん}→中心：01467_chuushin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: heterocentric

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{同性愛|どうせいあい}→同性愛：23993_douseiai⟧: homosexuality — attraction to the same sex
- {両性愛|りょうせいあい}: bisexuality — attraction to both sexes
- {性的指向|せいてきしこう}: sexual orientation — the umbrella concept
